comparison.objective: Clamp locking pliers onto a marked tube so they remain attached unaided.
comparison.physical_skill: Position a handheld tool and squeeze its sprung handles past a hidden over-centre lock point.
comparison.success_condition: Pliers self-support on the band, level within 10°, still, and untouched. No numeric clamping-force or cyclic performance threshold is supplied.
comparison.reason: Tests discovering successful over-centre engagement on release, not unlocking, tuning, relocking, and testing a separate dynamic mechanism.
